requestKind.description: Availability scope; omitted means text. Raw constraints retain every scope.

model.description: Optional model id/alias the caller intends to spend against. When present, each snapshot's availability.state is computed against this model (case-insensitive alias containment in either direction), so windows scoped to OTHER models never report the subject exhausted.

ControlQuotaRefreshRequest.description: Optional POST /v2/quota body; an empty or absent body keeps the model-agnostic projection.
